description.la: Commentarius in librum Ecclesiastes, in duodecim capitulis. Textus ex editione Quaracchi (Opera omnia VI, 1893), ex scanno OCR, sine notis criticis.
description.en-US: Bonaventure’s commentary on the book of Ecclesiastes, in twelve chapters. The Latin is the Quaracchi edition (Opera omnia VI, 1893) from an OCR scan, without the editors’ critical notes.

sources.edition: S. Bonaventurae Opera omnia, tom. VI (Ad Claras Aquas, Quaracchi: Collegium S. Bonaventurae, 1893), pp. 1-103.
sources.description: Archive.org OCR (djvu.xml word coordinates) of the folio edition. Each page is read in two columns; marginal notes, running heads, the editors’ footnotes (variant readings, cross-references) and small-type notes are removed by layout (line pitch and measure); line-end hyphens are joined; recognisable OCR slips are corrected by a lexicon pass, so some remain. Chapters are cut at the page whose running head names them.
sources.tierEvidence: Bonaventure died in 1274; the Quaracchi edition of 1893 is public domain.
